records.name: Elena Vasquez

safehouse.content: Charter Hill, Skyline Tower, apt 2207. Two bodyguards, rotating 12h shifts.

records.name: Militech

fields.ICE PROFILE: Wisp patrols, Hellhound attack daemons on core nodes

records.body:
Standard advice applies: do not get caught. Militech response teams average four minutes in Watson.

Warehouse 77 is their least defended logistics node, which still means armed guards and a live netrunner on call.

records.name: Warehouse 77 Recon

fields.PAYOUT: 500eb per operator, bonus for the black box

records.body:
Find out what Militech is really moving through Warehouse 77.

Leads:
- The relay host on this subnet carries their orders (encrypted)
- A pirate broadcast on the old FM band mentions a backdoor
- The camera system is called WATCHDOG
